label: rejected
reviewer: blind fresh agent (renders + close-ups + gate report + rubric only)

evidence.V1: Front, three-quarter and silhouette read instantly as a katana (curved blade, oval tsuba, banded grip, kashira knob); top view is a small blob, as expected for a sword; no correctness failure: A15 Y error 0.0, alignment offsets 0.0, all three seats seated with no gap
evidence.V2: Clear hierarchy: long curved blade (big), tsuba + wrapped grip (medium), habaki block, wrap bands, kashira cap and blade ridge line (small)
evidence.V3: Proportions sit close to a real katana (thin blade, small tsuba, short slim grip), so it reads only partly stylised; the stylised kit would want a chunkier tsuba/habaki and thicker blade
evidence.V4: Chamfers are consistent and catch light on the tsuba rim, habaki, kashira rings and blade shinogi ridge in the studio close-ups
evidence.V5: Minor issues: visible polygon faceting on the low-segment tsuba rim and kashira (each facet a distinct tone), an uneven dark crescent seam between the kashira ring and dome cap, and a slight pinch where facets converge at the kissaki apex
evidence.V6: Disciplined: steel greys blade, gold accent fittings, ink-dark tsuba face, one teal hue on the wrap; good value contrast
evidence.V7: 2172 tris vs weapon target 2500 (ceiling 4000): at or under target
evidence.V8: One white vertex-colour material and kit palette match, but the wrap hue reads as essentially one value (no 3-value ramp, no warm cream) and the faceted cylinders do not match the kit's smooth shading
evidence.V9: Studio line correct: Tool Handle, origin at grip, CollisionFidelity Hull, CanCollide off when equipped, Massless, MeshPart.Color white, SmoothPlastic

artifacts: Kashira close-up: uneven dark crescent seam/gap between the gold ring and the dome cap (thick in the middle, closing at the sides); the gate report has no seat entry for the kashira
Faceting: tsuba outer rim and kashira/grip cylinders show polygon facets, each with its own tone, in both studio and flat close-ups
Kissaki: slight pinch/notch where the ridge facets converge at the tip apex
cross_shell_overlaps 182 (allowed as intentional interpenetrating shells, but worth checking it is not the cause of the kashira seam)
top_fixes: Raise the segment count (or fix the smoothing/auto-smooth split) on the tsuba rim, grip and kashira so the cylinders shade smoothly like the kit
Seat the kashira dome flush against its ring (or make the groove an even, deliberate bevel) and add a kashira seat check
Push the stylisation: thicker tsuba and habaki, slightly wider blade and chunkier grip for a confident kit read
Give the wrap hue a 3-value ramp (dark under-wrap, mid band, light highlight) per the kit palette rule
Clean up the kissaki apex so the ridge facets meet without a pinch
